hometown: A calendar invite that never came
care: Do not reschedule. It will be rescheduled for you.
worstMemory:
Said "we should totally get coffee" four separate times across two years. We have never had coffee.

I drink a lot of coffee. It's not a supply issue.
pairsBadlyWith: A Google Calendar with no free slots until Q3

hometown: Split the bill evenly (they had three cocktails)
care: Send a reminder. Watch it be ignored. Repeat monthly.
worstMemory: Ordered the wagyu, said "let's just split it," then left before the check came. The request has been pending since the Obama administration in my heart.
pairsBadlyWith: The phrase "I'll get you next time"

productName: Former Roommate, Cast Iron Not Included
care: Hand wash only. They will not.
worstMemory: Moved out on a Tuesday and took the seasoned cast iron I had been babying for three years. Left a single fork. Not even a nice fork.
pairsBadlyWith: A sticky note that says "pls clean"

productName: The Man Who Explained My Job to Me
hometown: The front row of every meeting
care: Mute on Zoom. Mute in person, if possible.
worstMemory: Interrupted my presentation to explain my own slide to me, incorrectly, while pointing at it.

productName: Only Texts When They Need a Favor
hometown: My DMs, once a year, with a question
care: Leave on read. Store in a cool, dark place, far away.
worstMemory:
"Hey stranger!! Long time!! Random question but can I crash at yours this weekend"

They did not ask how I was. Ever.
pairsBadlyWith: A moving truck you didn't sign up to help load

hometown: A group chat with 40 people, muted
care: Archive chat. Do not unmute for any reason.
